#!/bin/bash

# LinEnum - Linux Enumeration Script
# Author: Rebootuser
# License: MIT License

# Check for root privileges
if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
   echo "This script must be run as root" 
   exit 1
fi

# Display system information
echo "============== System Information =============="
uname -a
echo "================================================="

# Check for users with UID 0
echo "============== UID 0 Users =============="
awk -F':' '{ if($3 == "0") print $1 }' /etc/passwd
echo "==============================================="
